english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who lacks social know-how and often says or does the wrong thing.

examples.english: They asked how much the salary was at their first interview; they were really gauche.
examples.traditional: 佢第一次見工就問人哋人工幾多，真係唔識做人。
